User-Item Matrix </div><div class="t m0 x2 ha y1c7 ff3 fs5 fc0 sc0 ls0 ws0">User ratings or interactions are organized into a matrix showing the re<span class="_ _3"></span>lationship between </div><div class="t m0 x2 ha y5a ff3 fs5 fc0 sc0 ls0 ws0">users and items. </div><div class="t m0 x2 hc y1c8 ff2 fs5 fc0 sc0 ls0 ws0">8. Recommendation Generation </div><div class="t m0 x2 ha y1c9 ff3 fs5 fc0 sc0 ls0 ws0">Based on similarity scores and user preferences, the system generates a list of re<span class="_ _3"></span>levant items </div><div class="t m0 x2 ha y1ca ff3 fs5 fc0 sc0 ls0 ws0">for the user. </div><div class="t m0 x2 hc y1cb ff2 fs5 fc0 sc0 ls0 ws0">9.
